[Research Associate · Kersten Lab · Cornell University]{.eyebrow}

# Philip Ruppert {.home-name}

::: {.home-lede}
I'm a molecular-nutrition scientist working out how diet is recorded in the
epigenome of fat tissue — and how that record sets the body's capacity to store
and burn energy, with consequences for metabolic health, aging, and resilience.
:::
